What is the Shared Folder?

This folder contains pooled and prepared sequence files that serve as the common starting input for the downstream clustering pipelines (OTU, ZOTU, TAC, TIC).

Files in this Folder

Sequences
sorted.fasta
What it is
The combined unique DNA sequences from all samples, sorted by their abundance (sequence count) across the entire dataset.
Use it for
Input to clustering algorithms (e.g., USEARCH cluster_otus and unoise3), which require sequences sorted from highest to lowest abundance.
Sequences
derep.fasta
What it is
Dereplicated sequences containing size annotations indicating how many times each sequence was observed.
Use it for
High-speed sequence dereplication and table building.
Table
relabel.tab
What it is
A mapping table connecting internal sequence labels to original sample identifiers and read IDs.
Use it for
Traceability back to the original FASTQ read headers.
